Jordan Lee (Platform): FYI postmortem posted: https://redwood.internal/pm/2026-03-08-metering-catchup. Incident summary: transient shard reassignment + pause in consumer group caused ~4.5h delayed token ingestion affecting ~510 accounts. We ran backfill but 120 accounts still show ledger divergence.
Maya Rao (FinOps): Thanks. We need a clear remediation runbook and owner for credits vs invoice patching. Also need ledger deltas in machine-readable format.
Sofia Kim (Customer Success): I can own customer communication for mid+ accounts and oversee credits for smaller accounts. Will need final list from infra + a recommended credit amount per account.
Ethan Wu (Eng Infra): Root cause notes: consumer paused during cluster rebalance; leader election caused message duplication protection to skip some compacted segments. Logs: 
```
2026-03-08T02:07:01Z broker[rebalance] INFO partition=55 reassigned
2026-03-08T02:07:06Z consumer[metering-consumer] ERROR paused_for_rebalance true, resume_failed
2026-03-08T02:09:30Z ingest[compaction] WARN missing_segment detected key_range=0-999
```
Ethan Wu (Eng Infra): Mitigations: (A) immediate: manual replay of compacted segments from cold storage for affected partitions, (B) medium: change consumer config to maintain offset tombstones for 24h after compaction, (C) long-term: add replica-aware replay pipeline. PRs: ingest#2625 (replay tool), ingest#2630 (offset tombstone retention).
Maya Rao (FinOps): Can infra produce a CSV with columns: account_id, observed_delta_tokens, proposed_credit_usd, ledger_tx_id_placeholder? We need that to validate credits and to decide invoice vs credit. Deadline for CSV: 2026-03-10 EOD.
Ethan Wu (Eng Infra): Yes. I'll add a dry-run export tool to tools/metering/export_delta.py. Example: 
```
python export_delta.py --start 2026-03-08T00:00Z --end 2026-03-08T06:30Z --dry-run --out deltas-20260308.csv
```
Ethan Wu (Eng Infra): Dry-run CSV ETA: 1766031200 (2026-03-09 18:00Z). Will attach to ENG-9140.
Sofia Kim (Customer Success): I'll prep templated comms: small accounts get automated portal notice, medium+ get personalized email + CS outreach. Comms draft due 2026-03-11.
Maya Rao (FinOps): Policy decision: credits under $10 auto-apply, $10-$200 requires invoice patch flow, >$200 triggers account manager review. I'll formalize and post in FIN-4973 by 2026-03-11.
billing-bot: AUTO: Created FIN-4973 to track invoice policy and FIN-4974 for credits queue. Linked ENG-9140, ingest#2625, ingest#2630.
Jordan Lee (Platform): Action owners agreed? Quick recap: Ethan = CSV + replay tool (ENG-9140 & ingest PRs), Sofia = comms + outreach, Maya = policy + final approval for invoice reissues, Jordan = weekly stakes & closure tracking.
Jordan SRE Bot: SCHEDULED: Weekly remediation check-in Wednesdays 10:00 PT (starting 2026-03-11). Invite posted to ENG-9140.
Ethan Wu (Eng Infra): Additional SRE ask: add a metric for partition_reassign_pause_seconds and alert when >120s. Jordan, can SRE add that?
Jordan Lee (Platform): @jordan_sre please add alert and dashboard panel. Set alert severity to P2 and point to runbook.
Maya Rao (FinOps): Audit requirements: keep ledger_tx_id and invoice_id mapping for each credit. Also require a short memo per customer explaining reason. We will not finalize credits without ledger entries.
Sofia Kim (Customer Success): Understood. I'll ensure the comms includes the memo and ledger references.
Ethan Wu (Eng Infra): Test plan for replay tool: run against staging snapshot, verify token parity for sample accounts, include checksum in CSV. Adding smoke test to CI.
Maya Rao (FinOps): Proposed timeline:
- 03/09: dry-run CSV (Ethan)
- 03/10: FinOps review and propose credit amounts (Maya)
- 03/11: Comms ready and policy finalized
- 03/12-03/15: Credits applied and invoice patches queued
Please flag if this is too aggressive.
Jordan Lee (Platform): Sounds reasonable. Update ENG-9140 and FIN-4974 with status. We'll keep the weekly cadence until FIN-4974 is CLOSED.
Sofia Kim (Customer Success): I'll open shared sheet and add CS + FinOps + Billing editors. Link will be posted to thread.
Ethan Wu (Eng Infra): CSV dry-run uploaded to ENG-9140 when ready. I will also tag PRs.
Maya Rao (FinOps): Setting FIN-4974 SLA to 14 days. If any accounts require manual invoice reissues beyond that, escalate to billing lead.
Jordan Lee (Platform): Final request: include a one-line rationale for any automated credit (scripted rule) in the memo. Keeps audit tidy.
Sofia Kim (Customer Success): Will do. Draft comms link: (placeholder) https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/REDACTED_COMMS
Maya Rao (FinOps): Thanks all. Next check-in Wed 2026-03-11 10am PT. If anyone runs into blockers earlier, ping ENG-9140 + FIN-4974. :pray:
